ns2:section.sectionText: The $56 class materials fee will be charged directly to your tuition bill. If you would like to add the course but you get a 'course full' error message, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in August. Until that time, please continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Food Science & Human Nutrition major(s).
